title: Observability, audit and recovery

subtasks.description: Define correlation IDs and stage latency/error/queue/GPU/usage-cost metrics with sensitive-field redaction.
Add append-only application audit events for authentication, settings, access-sensitive exports, reviews, actions and deletion.
Deliver audit records to a separately protected sink and document integrity/retention/reconstruction procedures.
Create actionable alerts for stopped workers, lease backlog, provider failure, purge failure and storage/capacity limits.
Back up relational data, object manifests, keys/configuration references and deletion state consistently.
Restore into an isolated environment, reapply tombstones and verify object/DB integrity and access policies.
Measure proposed RPO 24h/RTO 8h and run incident/support drills with no transcript or secret leakage in diagnostics.

dependency_note: Telemetry design starts with WP01; dependency list describes full recovery acceptance, not the earliest permissible work.
